lead_headline: Tavern on Blake reopens today after $1M rebuild—restaurant tracker flags 6 new openings this week across City Park, Cherry Creek, Five Points

restaurant.blurb: 6 new leads today—Tavern on Blake reopens after year-long rebuild, Läderach Swiss chocolate debuts Cherry Creek, Miya Moon replaces Honey Basil on Broadway. Five Points, Cherry Creek, Baker neighborhoods active.

liquor.blurb: Zero applications today—sixth straight day dormant as post-June 14 backlog freeze extends into second full week. 7-day total remains frozen at 369 licenses, all processed during Saturday's mass clearance event. System shows no new submissions, status changes, or removals since weekend spike, with sustained void now matching longest drought on record. Prior week's 350-application dump represented database catch-up following two-week shutdown rather than organic filing surge.

reputation.blurb: 8 mentions yesterday—Friday rebounds from Thursday's single-citation collapse, pushing 7-day total to 55 mentions across 14 sources, up 12% week-over-week. Denver Post leads with 21 citations (38% of volume), covering Broomfield defense plant, RiNo lease battles, Southlake Whole Foods. Facebook contributed 9 mentions, Instagram 5, Reddit 4. Week's recovery from mid-period slump restores monthly pace (203 total) to Q2 baseline as final third approaches. Google News RSS remains sole discovery channel.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +1 yesterday (1 new, 0 canceled) breaks week-long dormancy, lifting MTD to +25 (+1.3/day) while 90-day net holds at +131. Friday's single addition ends longest acquisition freeze since April, though current week's +12 net still trails prior period's +8 through comparable Friday, suggesting June's volatility persists. Recent fortnight shows clustering pattern—five-day burst Jun 11-18 delivered +16 net before Thursday-Friday collapse—matching MTD velocity (+1.3) to YTD baseline (+1.3) as mid-month volatility stabilizes around long-term trend.
